content: उपग्रह् €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To hold under, seize or collect from below; as रसम्. .²2 To seize, take, take possession of; तवैव पादावुपगृह्य <ls>Rām.</ls>; उपगृह्यास्पदं चैव <ls>Ms. 7. 184</ls>. .²3 To meet with, obtain; स मृत्युमुपगृह्णाति गर्भमश्वतरी यथा <ls>Chāṇ. 19</ls>. .²4 To subdue, vanquish. .²5 To provide. .²6 To conciliate, take as oneʼs ally, favour, support; तदुपगृहीतेन म्लेच्छराजबलेन <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²7 To conceive with oneʼs mind, grasp mentally; धियोपगृह्णन्स्मितशोभितेन <ls>Bhāg. 3. 22. 21</ls>. .²8 To decide, determine. .²9 To accept, approve.
